    Everyone plays on their own device, no second window needed. Up to 4 hikers. The host keeps the time, weather and campfire for everyone.

    Roof style (T)

    Pick a log (1/2/3), point where it goes and click or press E. Corners interlock and the courses stack up. At 9 courses the roof unlocks; cut a door and windows any time. Trees you clear near a cabin won't grow back. Inside a roofed cabin you're sheltered from storms. G opens this menu.

    Scrubbing storm time pauses the storm so you can hold a moment. Storms also roll in on their own every few days. Key: B opens this menu. Tip: click the owl to see the valley through its eyes.

    PAPERLAND TRAILS:

    OREGON WILDS
    Map
    • MoveWASD or arrow keys. Hold Shift to run.Drag the joystick. Hold Run to run.
    • CameraDrag the scene to tilt and turn, scroll to zoom, double-click to reset. Q R turn, − = zoom, V resets.Drag the scene to tilt and turn, pinch to zoom, double-tap to reset.
    • TestingPress T or tapTap Time to set the time of day, and L or Light to tune fog, contrast and lights.
    • UsePress E near somethingTap Use near something to pick up sticks, chop trees for more sticks (stand still while you chop), forage berries, feed the fire or rest in the tent.
    • FishingPress 2 (or F)Tap Fishing pole to hold your rod, face water and cast. After a bite, hold EUse to keep the marker in the green until the fish is landed. Cook fish at the fire.
    • GorgeOn the Canyon Gorge map, ladders take you down to the plunge pool and river, or free climb anywhere along the rock walls (slower, costs energy). A rope bridge sways across. No predators there.
    • Wolf friendNow and then a curious wolf trots up with a fish in its thought bubble. Feed it a fish to tame it: it follows you, chases off wild wolves and stands up to the bear. Keep its Wolf bar up with fish or it leaves.
    • HungerEat berries from the red-dotted bushes. Spare handfuls are eaten automatically.
    • WarmthNights are cold. Stand by the lit campfire to warm up.
    • EnergyWalking tires you. Rest in the tent; sleeping at dusk skips the night.
    • WildlifeDeer flee. Wolves watch and circle, and berries make them curious, but you can outrun them. Never step inside the bear's red ring.

    Keep the fire fed: wolves won't come near a burning campfire. If you collapse, you'll wake somewhere else and your camp will still be there.
